DAO

class DAO[source]

Bases: ABC, Generic[T]

Generic interface for CRUD operations on persistent entities.

This abstract base class defines the data access object (DAO) pattern with type-safe operations for any entity type T.

Methods

insert(obj)

Insert a new object and return its identifier.

update(obj)

Update an existing object in the persistent storage.

delete(obj_id)

Delete the object with the given identifier.

select(obj_id)

Retrieve an object by its identifier.

list()

Retrieve all objects of type T.

abstract insert(obj)[source]

Insert a new object and return its identifier.

Parameters:
objT

The object instance to be persisted.

Returns:
int

The identifier assigned to the new object. Most implementations return 0 on failure.

abstract update(obj)[source]

Update an existing object in the persistent storage.

Parameters:
objT

The object with updated values. Its identifier must match an existing record.

Returns:
bool

True if the object was updated, False otherwise (e.g. if the object does not exist).

abstract delete(obj_id)[source]

Remove the object with the given identifier.

Parameters:
obj_idint

Identifier of the object to be deleted.

Returns:
bool

True if the object was deleted, False otherwise (e.g. if no object has the given ID).

Parameters:

Identifier of the object to retrieve.

Returns:
